label: DomainAgent
description: An epistery domain contract (Agent.sol from epistery-host) — a domain's on-chain presence: its host key, owner, and access lists. Epistery-published vocabulary; the contract state is re-readable by anyone, scan's copy is a cache of it.

trust.note: Reserved — domain trust factors (bidirectional domain binding, host key continuity) declared here as the market defines them. The domainBinding signal already feeds the rung ladder.
